authority.if_main_advances: Review differences and rebind authority; never discard other work or auto-promote new fit outputs.

prohibited_in_this_phase: new posterior simulations or predictive resimulation
inference-likelihood edits applied to selected runs
data-dependent selection of favorable origins or estimator cells

input_policy.input_selection: publication manifest artifact_run_root, with documented run_root fallback only when declared
input_policy.default_partial_member_policy: not enabled for audited complete inputs

score_policy.original: preserve old quantile-grid scores and skill with original identity
score_policy.sensitivity_formula: A-D/(m*(m-1)); only eligible random-sample interpretations and m>1
score_policy.skill_sensitivity: No adjusted-CRPSS column in this phase
score_policy.analytic_reference_changes: separate optional representation, not replacement of primary frozen grid

quantile_policy.existing_HE4_targets: preserve frozen per-day predicted_quantile values for four principal competitors
quantile_policy.selected_multivariate_figure: R type8; demonstrated .05-.95 parity and figure .025/.975 contract
quantile_policy.other_stochastic_model_new_quantiles: R type8, explicitly new diagnostic convention
quantile_policy.tie: y==q on frozen numeric values; no tolerance-based rounding
quantile_policy.discrete_quantile_interpretation: P(Y<q_tau)<=tau<=P(Y<=q_tau); report both rates and counts

scale_policy.distribution_values: expm1 each original value once; no clipping or winsorization
scale_policy.declared_quantiles_and_limits: expm1 of authoritative log-scale quantile/limits; do not silently recompute interpolated quantiles after transform
scale_policy.figure_linked_events: compare on unchanged log-scale event to preserve published endpoints and avoid numerical inverse-transform ambiguity

tolerances.display: unrounded values stored; round scores only for display; do not decide equality from printed rounding

schemas.invariant: one canonical target quantile definition per method-case-level; optional alternative roles separate
one canonical95% interval per method-case; figure-reconciliation metadata separate

schemas.interpretation: descriptive raw-product behavior, not a new fitted lead-error model
five origins per available lead; no naive independent-day uncertainty

metadata_contract.scope: representative selected coefficient table; no universal fixed state layout assumed for other families

protected_article_policy.approximation_caption_default: adjacent source-text explanation and cross-references; existing wrappers remain
protected_article_policy.new_wrapper_if_required: new versioned filename, same stable label/old rows, old file retained; deliberate manifest/test update with numerical protection intact
protected_article_policy.new_settings_display: exact Decimal input to integer-coefficient scientific expressions; no loss from score-table5decimal convention

optional_precision_gates.name: provenance
optional_precision_gates.require: selected run/input/exporter/source snapshot and exact generation phase identified

optional_precision_gates.name: source_mapping
optional_precision_gates.require: historical rows,forecast lists,member updates and savedlabels explicitly agree

optional_precision_gates.name: update_phase
optional_precision_gates.require: QQQ and compared moments belong to the same update, or restrict to directly applied saved values with proven labels

optional_precision_gates.name: array_semantics
optional_precision_gates.require: quantile/source/lead/member IDs complete; all included variances finite positive

optional_precision_gates.name: meaning
optional_precision_gates.require: sum_i1/Q is conditional working-fit precision, not posterior mixture weight,causal influence or independent member count

release_gates.require: authority reviewed and immutable source snapshot complete
isolated branches/worktrees,new bounded output directory,no fit-stage side effects
each task has explicit completion/skip/block/defer status; optional omissions remove includes cleanly
old scores/predictions/coefficients/figures and protectedfile hashes unchanged; new estimator identities separate
reviewer resolution accurately distinguishes reporting/assessment from untested empirical claims
article sources,new generatedassets and inventories agree; no blank future results or dangling references
meaningful new tests and existing preservation checks pass; stable PDF visually inspected; exact stagedtree built
reviewed commits crosslinked and promoted to main under authorization; local/remote SHAs verified; no force-push

resources.algorithm: O(m log m) sorting per case; no m-by-m pairwise arrays in production
resources.runtime: measure actual runtime; no promised or unmeasured fit-time estimate
resources.optional_discovery_scope: listed selected roots and declared exports only; no broad disk-recovery search

bounded_version_control_exceptions: If needed, add scoped ignore/attribute exceptions for the declared new artifact/evidence subtree only; validate all checksummed files from an exact staged checkout.

driver_contract.article_portable_replay: use input_snapshot_relpath inside bundle; original absolute runtime path is provenance only
driver_contract.article_generator_write_scope: only declared new includes/artifacts after all input/protection checks

figure_policy.primary_scope: selected model and key references; show horizons distinctly; exhaustive model/origin counts in tables/bundle
figure_policy.new_line_styles: color plus distinguishable line types/markers consistent with completed editorial revision
figure_policy.old13includes: preserve original13 sources; validate all additional includes independently rather than weaken old source protection

coefficient_diagnostic_repair.required_part: N11a source-only historical-index fix and regression
coefficient_diagnostic_repair.fix_contract: select actual hist_idx for historical coefficient variance; keep correctly prefix-indexed forecast uses compatible
coefficient_diagnostic_repair.optional_part: N11b regenerate only from proven saved late-time covariance/draws

sampler_scope_task.required: N12a target/formulation scope audit and accurate text
sampler_scope_task.conditional: N12b complete-formulation corrections only with derivation evidence
